name: git-commit-message
description: Generate concise Conventional Commit messages from conversation context and git diff.

interface.longDescription: Bundle the ggm and ggm-p skills for generating Conventional Commit messages from conversation context and the current git diff. Use ggm for message-only output, or ggm-p to select relevant files, check likely privacy leakage, and create a commit.
defaultPrompt: Generate a commit message for this change
Commit the relevant files with ggm-p
Write a Conventional Commit message from the diff
